title: Ruth and Naomi
note: Ruth clings to her mother-in-law and refuses to go back to her own people, and the whole of loyalty is in the grip of one woman on another. A friendship chosen against every obligation.
source_title: File:'Ruth and Naomi' by Jan Victors, 1653.jpg

title: The Visitation
note: Two women greet each other outside a house, and the friendship is entirely in the angle of two bodies leaning in. Giotto makes the embrace architectural.
source_title: File:Giotto - Scrovegni - -16- - Visitation.jpg

title: Achilles Tending the Wound of Patroclus
note: One warrior bandages the arm of the other and neither of them looks up. The most tender image of friendship in ancient painting, and it is almost entirely a matter of two bowed heads.
source_title: File:Akhilleus Patroklos Antikensammlung Berlin F2278.jpg
source_artist: Sosias (potter, signed). Painting attributed to the Sosias Painter (name piece for Beazley, overriding attribution) or t

title: David and Jonathan
note: Jonathan collapses into David's arms while Saul's anger burns behind a curtain. Rembrandt paints the farewell of friends as one dark mass with two heads.
source_title: File:Harmensz van Rijn Rembrandt - Давид и Ионафан - Google Art Project.jpg

title: Two Men Contemplating the Moon
note: Two men stand with their backs to us looking at the same thing, and the friendship is entirely in the identical posture. Friedrich paints company as a shared direction of attention.
source_title: File:Friedrich - Two Men Contemplating the Moon.jpg

title: The Concert
note: Three people make music in a room and the friendship is in the tuning: each of them is listening rather than looking. Vermeer paints company as a shared surface of light.
source_title: File:Vermeer The Concert.jpg

title: The Musicians
place: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
note: Four young men rehearse a song, one of them seen only as a face in the shadow. Caravaggio arranges a group of friends as a single piece of theatre.
source_title: File:The Musicians MET DP-687-001.jpg

title: The Three Musicians
note: Three men sing and play at a plain table, and the comedy is in the way they look at each other rather than at us. Velázquez paints friendship as an exchange of glances.
source_title: File:Diego Velázquez - The Three Musicians - Google Art Project.jpg

title: The Concert
note: A group of musicians gathers around a candlelit table, one of them singing from a book. Honthorst paints company as a circle of light with four faces in it.
source_title: File:Honthorst - Le Concert, 1624, INV 1364.jpg

title: Music in the Tuileries Gardens
note: Manet crowds his friends into a garden bandstand until the friendship is a density rather than a set of faces. A group portrait dissolved into a crowd.
source_title: File:MANET - Música en las Tullerías (National Gallery, Londres, 1862).jpg

title: Hommage à Delacroix
note: Ten artists stand and sit around a portrait of a dead painter, and the homage is arranged as a row of pale faces in dark coats. Friendship as a shared debt.
source_title: File:Hommage à Delacroix - Henri Fantin-Latour.jpg

title: A Studio at Les Batignolles
note: Manet paints at his easel while his friends gather round him, and the group is arranged as a pyramid of attention. Friendship as the act of watching someone work.
source_title: File:Henri Fantin-Latour - A Studio at Les Batignolles - Google Art Project.jpg

title: The Studio on the Rue de la Condamine
note: Bazille paints his own studio from the inside with his friends scattered up a staircase. A group portrait built as a room.
source_title: File:Frédéric Bazille - Bazille's Studio - Google Art Project.jpg

title: Van Gogh Painting Sunflowers
note: Gauguin paints his friend from behind, hunched over the canvas, and the portrait is mostly of the act of painting. Friendship recorded as shared work.
source_title: File:Paul Gauguin - Vincent van Gogh painting sunflowers - Google Art Project.jpg

title: Claude Monet Painting by the Edge of a Wood
note: Monet stands at the edge of a wood with his palette and Sargent paints him working rather than resting. Companionship recorded as shared attention.
source_title: File:John Singer Sargent - Claude Monet Painting by the Edge of a Wood - N04103 - National Gallery.jpg

title: The Card Players
note: Two men play cards and say nothing, and the friendship is entirely in the table between them. Cézanne paints company as a shared plane.
source_title: File:Les Joueurs de cartes, par Paul Cézanne.jpg

title: In a Café (L'Absinthe)
note: A woman and a man sit side by side, each of them looking past the other. Degas paints companionship as two people occupying the same silence.
source_title: File:Edgar Degas - In a Café - Google Art Project 2.jpg

title: The Balcony
note: Three friends stand and sit on a balcony and none of them looks at any of the others, with a fourth figure in the doorway behind. Manet paints company as three separate acts of attention in one frame.
source_title: File:Edouard Manet - The Balcony - Google Art Project.jpg

title: Snap the Whip
place: Butler Institute of American Art, Youngstown
note: Boys run in a line holding hands, and the friendship is the chain itself. Homer paints a group as one continuous shape across a field.
source_title: File:Winslow Homer - Snap the Whip (Butler Institute of American Art).jpg

title: The Swimming Hole
note: Six young men swim in a quarry and the friendship is the arrangement of bodies in the landscape. Eakins builds a group out of geometry, water and light.
source_title: File:Thomas Eakins - Swimming (1895).jpg

title: Two Old Men Disputing (Peter and Paul)
note: Two old men lean over a book, one of them talking and the other listening. Rembrandt paints a long friendship as an argument about a text.
source_title: File:Two Old Men Disputing (“St. Peter and St. Paul”).jpg

title: Two Old Men Eating Soup
medium: Oil on plaster transferred to canvas
note: Two old men eat at a bare table, one of them with a skull's face at the spoon. Goya paints old company as a black joke about the body.
source_title: File:Viejos comiendo sopa.jpg

title: Gauguin's Chair
note: A chair, a candle and two books, and nobody in the room. Van Gogh paints a friend by painting his empty place, which is the most abstract portrait in this gallery.
source_title: File:Vincent van Gogh - De stoel van Gauguin - Google Art Project.jpg

title: Gassed
note: A line of blinded soldiers walks with each man's hand on the shoulder of the one in front. Sargent paints comradeship as the only way anyone gets anywhere.
source_title: File:Sargent, John Singer (RA) - Gassed - Google Art Project.jpg

title: The Yellow House
note: Van Gogh paints the house he had furnished for a friend who had not arrived yet. Friendship as a building, and as a wait.
source_title: File:Vincent van Gogh - The yellow house ('The street').jpg
